SILT#00012: Some date can be known as Internation Prime Dates (this has nothing to do with Amazon's Prime Days). This means that a (Gregorian calendar) date is prime when written in MMDDYY (American), DDMMYY (European), and YYYYMMDD (ISO) formats. Next date is: 2027-03-23

## Additional Context

- First heard on [Ep. 105 (Next Prime Dates and Ancient Gag Rates) of A Problem Squared](https://creators.spotify.com/pod/show/a-problem-squared)
- Original Blogpost: ["Today’s an international prime day" posted on 2013-11-29 by John D. Cook](https://www.johndcook.com/blog/2013/11/29/todays-a-prime-day/)
